adjudication.rationale: In `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, the computed keys use `z.string().toString()` and `z.string().optional().toString()`. Those expressions evaluate at runtime to a string (very likely the same `"[object Object]"`), so both computed properties collide and the latter overwrites the former. As a result, the schema does not enforce the intended rule (“any numeric property is the expiry”) and instead defines (at most) a single literal key, breaking validation behavior when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is true.
